title: What Makes Interruptions Disruptive? (Borst, Taatgen, van Rijn, CHI 2015)
snippet: Computational cognitive model of task interruption/resumption based on the 'problem state bottleneck': disruptiveness driven by interruption duration, interrupting-task complexity, and moment of interruption; problem-state requirements of BOTH tasks predict disruption.
quote: The experiments confirmed that problem state requirements are an important predictor for the disruptiveness of interruptions. This suggests that interfaces should be designed to a) interrupt users at low-problem state moments and b) maintain the problem state for the user when interrupted.
